todo_write.description: Record and update a task list to plan multi-step work and show progress. Add one todo per concrete step before you start. Finish tasks, append or reorder work, and start pending tasks in that order; use finish and start together for direct transitions. Completed tasks are immutable.

parameters.todos: New main task descriptions to append, or replacements when reorderFrom is set. Omit when only changing task states.
parameters.reorderFrom: Existing task number at which to remove unfinished tasks from the current plan and append replacements. Omit to append todos or only change task states.
parameters.finish: Number of the current in-progress main task to complete before any planning changes.
parameters.start: Number of the pending main task to start after any planning changes. Earlier tasks in the current plan must be completed.

todo_read.description: Read the current main task list and active issue, or export the complete task history to a temporary JSON file.

parameters.full: When true, exports the full history, including completed and removed tasks, plan changes, and issue reports. When false or omitted, returns the current plan starting from the most recently completed task.

todo_report.description: Identify the main task and current issue context. While a main task is in progress, call exactly once before non-todo tools in every tool-using assistant message.

parameters.index: Number of the in-progress main task shown by todo_read. Switching main tasks requires the previous one to be completed or the plan to be explicitly reordered.
parameters.inIssue: Set true for any distinct concrete issue within the main task, including focused inspection, research, implementation, debugging, or verification, even when quick. Set false only for work directly serving the main task as a whole without a separate issue.
parameters.issue: A short, stable name for the issue. Required to enter or change an issue. When inIssue is true, omit it to continue the current issue without renaming it; still call todo_report. When inIssue is false, always omit it.
